propositions: Six prior process improvement proposals must be evaluated against historical audits, janitor work, architecture decisions, and implementation outcomes before conversion into new work; each requires explicit disposition (reaffirm/refine/reconsider/defer) with recovered rationale and new evidence.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was implemented as optional, fail-open creation capture; coverage remains 1.1% but automation-driven sources (2-3 agents) show adoption; recommendation refines to expand automatic stamping at known filer boundaries rather than mandate global fields.

Deterministic plan preflight floors at P1-P11 (not P1-P8); prior work rejected spec-by-example and risk-assumption blockers; incremental criterion re-review is unsafe; recommendation extends floor only for mechanically decidable recurrent failures with offline validation and fail-open behavior.

Completion-failure classification must first derive offline categories from 351 existing FAIL sidecars with 682 structured findings; treating all non-PASS outcomes as escaped defects is invalid; recommendation defers schema addition pending classifier validation.

Risk-tiered review signals (security/store surfaces, diff breadth, complexity, plan failures) warrant pilot reporting and measurement but not hard enforcement; human-review framing is inapplicable because the project uses autonomous agentic Gerrit process.

Proactive debt management and autonomous-governance proposals require removal of completed work (720-LOC warning shipped), rejection of arbitrary duplication quotas, and refocus on author/reviewer agent independence, provider diversity, override auditing, and operational succession rather than human breadth.
